related.title: Rosetta 彗星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：至少排除表面雜波並給出 εr 範圍後才報告厚度區間，保留材料身份未定。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report a thickness interval only after excluding surface clutter and bounding εr; leave material identity unresolved. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用球對稱重力估算速度尺度，指出不能直接拿來設計真實近彗星軌道。
related.differenceEn: Estimate a velocity scale with spherical gravity and explain why it cannot directly design a real near-comet orbit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成地表與深部回波相差 10 μs，c=3×10⁸ m/s，εr=4。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=3×10⁸×10⁻⁵/(2sqrt(4))。 結果約 750 m。均勻無色散介質中 d=cΔt/(2sqrt(εr))；亮回波不能單獨證明液態水。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學引力參數 μ=650 m³/s²，距質心 r=3000 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ve=sqrt(2×650/3000)。 結果約 0.658281 m/s。球對稱近似逃逸速率 ve=sqrt(2μ/r)；忽略自轉、噴流、太陽潮汐與形狀。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic surface-to-subsurface delay is 10 μs, c=3×10⁸ m/s and εr=4. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=3×10⁸×10⁻⁵/(2sqrt(4)). Result ≈ 750 m. For a uniform nondispersive medium d=cΔt/(2sqrt(εr)); a bright echo alone cannot establish liquid water.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching gravitational parameter μ=650 m³/s² and center distance r=3000 m. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ve=sqrt(2×650/3000). Result ≈ 0.658281 m/s. Spherical escape speed ve=sqrt(2μ/r) neglects rotation, jets, solar tides and shape.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kaguya 月球探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：至少排除表面雜波並給出 εr 範圍後才報告厚度區間，保留材料身份未定。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Report a thickness interval only after excluding surface clutter and bounding εr; leave material identity unresolved. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 以簡化立體影像幾何理解視差誤差如何影響高程精度。
related.differenceEn: Use simplified stereo geometry to understand propagation of disparity error into height precision.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成地表與深部回波相差 10 μs，c=3×10⁸ m/s，εr=4。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=3×10⁸×10⁻⁵/(2sqrt(4))。 結果約 750 m。均勻無色散介質中 d=cΔt/(2sqrt(εr))；亮回波不能單獨證明液態水。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學高度 H=100 km、基線 B=20 km、焦距 f=1000 pixel、視差誤差 σd=0.2 pixel。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：σh=100²×0.2/(1000×20) km=0.1 km。 結果約 100 m。近似垂直攝影中 σh≈H²σd/(fB)，f 與 σd 必須使用相同像面單位；不處理遮蔽。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic surface-to-subsurface delay is 10 μs, c=3×10⁸ m/s and εr=4. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=3×10⁸×10⁻⁵/(2sqrt(4)). Result ≈ 750 m. For a uniform nondispersive medium d=cΔt/(2sqrt(εr)); a bright echo alone cannot establish liquid water.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching H=100 km, baseline B=20 km, focal length f=1000 pixels and disparity uncertainty 0.2 pixels. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: σh=100²×0.2/(1000×20) km=0.1 km. Result ≈ 100 m. For near-nadir stereo σh≈H²σd/(fB); f and σd must share image-plane units. Occlusion is excluded.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
